title: MemberProvisioningChangeResponseDataType
description: Response for Member Upsert provisioning requests.

code.description: Outcome code: OK, PENDING, MEMBER_EXISTS, or ERROR.

description.description:
Human readable explanation of the code. Examples:
- OK: The member change has been accepted and processed.
- PENDING: The change has been accepted but processing is pending.
- MEMBER_EXISTS: A member with the same identifier already exists.
- ERROR: An internal error occurred; see errorMessage for details.

errorMessage.description: Optional error details or stack trace when code is ERROR.
